name: @evanlouie/vimium-webkit
description: Vimium-style keyboard control for WebKit userscript managers

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.src.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.node.json build/check-effects.ts
scripts.repos:update:effect: git fetch --no-tags https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect.git main && git rm -rq repos/effect && git read-tree --prefix=repos/effect/ -u FETCH_HEAD && git commit -m 'chore(repos): update Effect' -m "Vendor Effect-TS/effect@$(git rev-parse --short=10 FETCH_HEAD) from main."
scripts.verify: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
